archive.projection: Matched temperature members and provenance only; original source editions are retained in the shared archive while available.

method: Latest identified daily GEFS edition actually collected at least six hours before each three-hour valid time; initialization lead 6 to 120 hours. Nearest station temperature within 30 minutes, QC V or G only. Latest available observation corrections are used. No forecast is fetched or reconstructed by this comparison.
interpretation: Descriptive local comparison, not calibrated probabilities or a model ranking. Members, adjacent times and repeated runs are correlated. Station terrain and elevation can differ from the uncorrected model grid. Counts inside the member range do not establish future coverage. Missing archives, members and readings remain unknown.
